notes.title: Update Nov 12th
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added support for rebinding Forward, Back, Left and Right movement keys. This should help goblins with AZERTY keyboards.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes Oct 29th
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Improved Spring Shoes so that you can execute air-jumps sooner.
[*] Fixed a bug where Shop item info was not shown when using a gamepad or Steam Deck
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes 30th September
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added support for French
[*] Added support for Spanish
[*] Fixed some bugs with The Arenas ending
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes 2024-09-23
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Access to the Gauntlet is now always visible (but locked until you complete The Arenas)
[*] Added new Retro visuals mode. See Options -> Visuals -> Retro
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes 2024-09-16
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added Gauntlet mode
[*] Added German language support
[*] Added Japanese language support
[*] Added Russian language support
[*] Heaps of smaller refinements & fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 2024-08-27
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where weapon would be unable to fire after visiting Pause menu.

notes.title: Patch Notes 2024-08-26
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with grapple and the ending.
[*] Fixed a bug where weapons could fire while paused.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 2024-08-22
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Tweaked the prices of Homestead items.
[*] Tweaked the amount of gold given in the arenas.
[*] Made it cheaper to afford items in the first arena.
[*] Changed the price of some upgrades.
[*] Fixed bug where sometimes music would overlap. 
[*] Fixed bug with not being able to use Glider while jumping. 
[*] Fixed bug with roller bombs being under the final arena.
[*] Fixed flyers sometimes appearing outside the arena.
[*] Fix held objects sometimes not counting towards blocking damage crowd pleaser.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 2024-08-21
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Refine goblin jump speeds.
[*] Increase goblin movement during jumps.
[*] Slightly change how Heavy bots react to goblin antics.
[*] Fix bug when starting training with no enemies.
[*] Fix bombs not showing as selected in training.
[*] Fix bug with look sensitivity resetting after rebinding actions.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 2024-08-20
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Increased range of Homing Bombs.
[*] Adjusted some gold-related upgrades.
[*] Made Tick Tick Nope upgrade stackable.
[*] Improved tutorial for Grab action.
[*] Fixed player appearing to take damage when equipping some items or upgrades.
[*] Fixed Buggy enemies sometimes not taking damage from explosives.
[*] Fixed Homing Bombs not targeting Rocketeer enemies.
[*] Attempted to fix invisible text on some Apple devices.
[*] Fixed bug when reseting progress.
[/list]
